paper_title: Updated constraints on axion-like particles from temporal information in supernova SN1987A gamma-ray data
notes: Headline result: ALP-photon coupling limit from ALP conversion in the Galactic magnetic field for SN1987A gamma-ray data, at 95% CL. Curve is the solid black 'This work (lambda_P)' line (profile-likelihood, temporal information included) from Fig. 3 left panel, extracted from the vector PDF figures/sn1987a_alp_conversion_limits.pdf (path idx 98, width 1.0, solid black). Axis calibration from major ticks: x 1e-11..1e-8 eV, y 1e-12..1e-10 GeV^-1. Limit is ~5.2e-12 GeV^-1 (flat) below ~1e-10 eV, dips to ~4.5e-12 near 4e-10 eV, then rises to ~8e-11 GeV^-1 at 1e-8 eV. The paper's novel contribution is that including temporal information (lambda_P) improves the conversion limit by a factor ~1.4 over the Gaussian-likelihood treatment (dashed grey 'This work (lambda_G)'). The paper also derives ALP-decay limits (Fig. 3 right, heavy ALPs keV-GeV) which do not improve on prior work; conversion is presented as the main new result. Not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence.
